description: This is a C# source file defining the UsersController class, which handles user-related API endpoints such as creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting users, as well as fetching user activity logs.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller class managing user operations via REST API endpoints, including create, read, update, delete, and activity retrieval.

methods.name: CreatOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new user, interacts with Keycloak API to register user, saves user to database, and logs audit action.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve list of all users from database.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve a specific user by ID.

methods.name: GetActivity
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve activity logs for a specific user, with optional limit.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE to remove a user by ID, with audit logging.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP PATCH to update user preferences based on JSON body.
